update.title: Added phone screenshots to Work Reports
update.summary: Extended Work Report’s screenshot collection to recognize phone captures as a distinct source while keeping them in the shared evidence-review flow.

blocks.body:
## Add another capture source

Work Report’s screenshot collection accepts phone captures alongside desktop screenshots. Both enter the same artifact discovery and review flow, avoiding a separate reporting path for each source.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Desktop[Desktop screenshots] --> Collection[Shared screenshot collection]
  Phone[Phone screenshots] --> Collection
  Collection --> Discovery[Work Report discovery]
  Discovery --> Review[Evidence review]
blocks.description: Desktop and phone screenshots enter the same Work Report collection, discovery, and evidence-review flow. Multiple screenshot sources converge on one Work Report collection and review path.

blocks.body:
## Preserve where evidence came from

Phone captures retain a distinct `phone-screenshot` type and `Phone screenshot:` label during collection. Their origin stays visible during review without changing how the underlying image is copied or handled.
